fields.cta.label: Start a conversation
fields.story1.title: Website strategy
fields.story1.body: Start with the people your website needs to help. We turn audience questions, business priorities and existing content into a clear page plan.
fields.story1.link: How a page plan takes shape
fields.story2.title: Brand and interface design
fields.story2.body: A recognisable website needs more than a logo. Colour, typography, photography and interaction should feel like parts of the same business.

fields.story3.body: Websites need attention as a business changes. A regular review helps keep contact information, services, software and the visitor journey current.

fields.masthead.name: Tracy Apple
fields.headline: A website your team can keep moving
fields.lede: An illustrative independent website studio bringing strategy, brand design and development together.
fields.intro: We wrote this for one group of readers. Businesses that need a clearer website and a practical way for their teams to keep it current.
fields.point1.title: Website development
fields.point1.body: A good design should remain useful after launch. We build pages around editable sections so your team can keep services, people and news up to date.
fields.point2.title: Content and photography
fields.point2.body: Specific words and relevant images help people understand what you do. We plan content around customer questions and choose visuals that explain the work.
fields.point3.title: Website care
fields.point3.body: Websites need attention as a business changes. A regular review helps keep contact information, services, software and the visitor journey current.
fields.product.title: Website toolkit
fields.product.body: Flexible pages, editable content and a consistent design language help your team keep the website moving.

fields.process.title: Four steps, in the same order every time
fields.step1.name: Discover the business
fields.step1.body: Map the audience, offer and customer questions before deciding what each page needs.
fields.step2.name: Shape the experience
fields.step2.body: Bring the message, visual identity and page structure together in concrete page concepts.
fields.step3.name: Build and review
fields.step3.body: Turn the agreed direction into editable pages and review the important visitor journeys.
fields.step4.name: Launch and learn
fields.step4.body: Hand over the content workflow and use regular reviews to keep the website useful.

fields.title: Type and colour at Tracy Apple
fields.summary: An illustrative independent website studio bringing strategy, brand design and development together.
fields.specimen.display: Every Tracy Apple page starts with one clear sentence.
fields.specimen.page: A page title names the page, never the whole studio.
fields.specimen.section: Sections read as a sequence of assertions.
fields.specimen.card: Service cards, plan cards and dialogs share this size.
fields.specimen.lead: The lead paragraph sets the pace: one idea, said once, in the studio voice.
fields.specimen.body: Body text carries the argument. It should read at arm’s length on a phone and stay calm on a wide screen, which is why the studio keeps a measure of about seventy characters.
fields.specimen.caption: Captions carry metadata, labels and helper lines, never anything the reader must not miss.
fields.voice.title: How the studio writes
fields.voice.rule1: Plain, specific English about the audience, the work and the next action.
fields.voice.rule2: Strategy, design, development, content and care are described as one offer: Website toolkit.
fields.voice.rule3: Plans, team profiles and imagery stay illustrative — never a customer endorsement.
